messages:
alex: Heads-up — proposing an unpin of runtime 2.15 in tonight's 03:00 UTC change window. Canary showed a kvcache memory leak on longseq workloads; unpin would route affected models back to 2.14 while we patch. Need to coordinate deploybot drainback + rollback criteria. @maria @kenji any objections?

maria: 👍 agree. Define rollback trigger: if tail latency (P99) increases by >200ms OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 15m. Also run a canary validation at 30m post-unpin and hold for 10m.

kenji: We should preserve GPU allocation for Dedicated tenants during drainback. Suggest adding a `no-evict` flag so reserved pools don't get rebalanced mid-drain.

deploybot: Automated: scheduling pin-unpin job. To confirm run: `/deploy pin update runtime:2.15 --action unpin --window 2026-03-24T03:00Z --drainback 15m` Reply with `confirm` to proceed.

alex: confirmed. I'll file a short rollback playbook in #eng-oncall with the thresholds and the exact rollback command.

rana: I'll be oncall tonight and will watch the metrics. If DBIO errors or OOM counts spike I'll initiate rollback immediately. Please route alerts to my oncall channel.

maria: Also request: set runtime logs for kvcache to DEBUG during the window so we can capture traces: example env `LOG_KVCACHE=debug`. Can we include that in the deploybot command?

kenji: ack — will include `no-evict=true` and `env=[LOG_KVCACHE=debug]` in the run. Also adding a cushioned drainback (start 15m before window close) to avoid sharp capacity swings.

deploybot: Command queued. Run ID: 202603240300-xyz. Actions: action=unpin, drainback=15m, no-evict=true, env=[LOG_KVCACHE=debug]. Will post status updates in this thread and emit deploy events to #deploy-notify.

alex: thanks. I'll update release notes & add rollback doc here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-unpin-2026-03-24 — tagging for visibility. :thumbsup:
